# Chapter 8-a — Group F: C-7Q

**Document:** `NH_MASTER-21_SYSTEM_BEHAVIOR_v0_1_CANDIDATE__CH08-a.md`  
**Status:** CANDIDATE  
**Source repository:** `nesgeva/NH-GOVERNANCE`  
**Source commit:** `6a7160ba688ba4e433a31899162815df7e2bab17`  

This piece covers privacy at capture, storage, internal use, visible output and non-destructive removal; six operations and two protection tiers; third-party and private-use policy; proposed enforcement mechanisms; all B7 record contracts and nine operation lifecycles; privacy-owned consumer interfaces; and the restored explicit influence-removal requirement. Full relevance and LMAC mechanics remain CH08-b/c, observation and learning CH08-d–g, identity/mode/access and output-delivery machinery CH09, connected paths CH11 and final registers CH12. Exact implementation serialization, technology, empirical calibration and visual layout remain open.

[SOURCE CONFLICT] V10 §7Q governs six operations, sealed preservation, non-destructive visibility deletion, preserved history, protected_complete/protected_with_declared_limits outcomes and separately authorized internal influence. Defaults §3G and Companion §7Q retain five-operation/destruction/tombstone wording, older verified_complete/completed_with_declared_limits outcomes and a broader unresolved-case block on internal use. The losing wording remains identified at the affected cards; no source is silently reconciled.

[SOURCE CONFLICT] V10 §7Q requires stronger authorization at each later third-party operation. Accepted A7 §§4.5/4.6/6.1 and B7 §§3/17 permit ordinary bounded interpretation without separate permission. V10 governs; compatible interpretation labels and full-simulation approval remain explicit.

[SOURCE CONFLICT] V10 §7Q requires stronger defaults for minors and vulnerable people. Accepted A7 §§4.7/6.2, B7 §§3/17 and Bundle 6 A30 remove automatic age/vulnerability restrictions. Bundle 5 §8 calls the V10 sentence frozen predecision wording and the accepted policy a settled slot; that competing explanation is preserved. Under build-contract §1.5 V10 still governs. CH04-e’s existing marked disagreement is carried forward.

Citation keys: V10 = `01_AUTHORITATIVE/NH_MASTER-20_CORRECTED_v10.md`; MAP = `02_WORKING_MAP/NH_COMPLETE_DESIGN_AND_WIRING_MAP_v1_6_CANDIDATE.md`; DD = `01_AUTHORITATIVE/NH_DECISION_DEFAULTS-S19_v2_2.md`; `04/` = `04_ACCEPTED_STANDALONE_DESIGNS/`; `05/` = `05_ACTIVE_CANDIDATE/`; `98/` = `98_HISTORICAL_SOURCES_PRE_V10/`, used only for the F9 passage expressly restored through FR-0108 by the cited September 25 decision record. ### C-7Q — Privacy, Deletion, Sensitive-data (§7Q)
Stamp: DESIGNED    Source: [V10 §7Q]

ALONE
- What it is: DESIGNED — The privacy authority for capture, protection, authorized internal use, visible access and non-destructive removal, conceptually designed and not built. [V10 §7Q]
- Takes in: DESIGNED — The requested operation and purpose, material references, applicable instructions, authorization facts and protection requirements. [V10 §7Q]
- Does: DESIGNED — Governs every stage before capture, during storage, retrieval and display, and during removal. Separates internal-use authorization from visible-output eligibility and review; privacy precedes relevance and is the first sequential output factor. [V10 §7Q] [MAP CY-B] [04/NH_BUNDLE_2_FORMAL_RELEVANCE_DECLARATIONS_AND_COMPLETION_v1_1_CANDIDATE.md §5.5]
- Gives out: DESIGNED — Recorded purpose-specific decisions, protected handling, honest removal outcomes and visibility or influence controls with their own scope. [V10 §7Q]
- Must never: DESIGNED — Admit excluded raw material to ordinary storage; store credentials or secrets in plain recoverable form; surface sensitive material merely because relevant; visibly resurface deleted content or its derivatives; treat deletion as influence removal; violate an explicit influence-removal instruction; display another person’s sensitive information without a designed authorizing rule; extend storage permission to display, sharing or output; claim partial deletion complete; or confirm complete removal without verifying all relevant visible locations. [V10 §7Q]
- Fails closed by: DESIGNED — Withholds unauthorized visible use, preserves protected content, leaves unverified cases unresolved and never widens access under uncertainty. [V10 §7Q]

Stamp: DESIGNED    Source: [V10 §7Q]

ALONE
- What it is: DESIGNED — Exclusion, sealed isolation, hiding, restriction, redaction and deletion, each with a different effect. [V10 §7Q]

- Does: DESIGNED — Keeps capture, protection, presentation, access restriction, partial visible removal and complete ordinary-visibility removal distinct. - Must never: DESIGNED — Merge the six operations, destroy material, or infer an internal influence stop from visible suppression. [V10 §7Q]
- Fails closed by: NOT DECIDED

### C-7Q.1.2 — Sealed isolation
Stamp: DESIGNED    Source: [V10 §7Q]

ALONE
- What it is: DESIGNED — Protected storage inside N.H under either Level 1 or Level 2. [V10 §7Q]
- Takes in: DESIGNED — Material requiring protected isolation, including credentials that may later expire, rotate or be revoked. [V10 §7Q]
- Does: DESIGNED — Keeps sealed material internally connected and usable under its protection rules. Invalid credentials become permanently inert historical records; they never function again. Only a separate explicit scoped instruction stops internal influence. [V10 §7Q]

- Fails closed by: DESIGNED — Withholds ordinary exposure while the protected transfer is incomplete. [V10 §7Q]

### C-7Q.10 — Shared privacy-operation discipline
Stamp: ACCEPTED    Source: [04/NH_B7_PRIVACY_ENFORCEMENT_AND_PROTECTED_HANDLING_ARCHITECTURE_v1_3_CANDIDATE.md §15]

ALONE
- What it is: ACCEPTED — The common mechanical contract binding all nine privacy operations. [04/NH_B7_PRIVACY_ENFORCEMENT_AND_PROTECTED_HANDLING_ARCHITECTURE_v1_3_CANDIDATE.md §15]

- Does: ACCEPTED — Commits each state transition atomically with append-only history. Every real operation has one operational record; recovery is separately recorded. Restart scans every nonterminal contract, trusts committed state only and resumes the last checkpoint without reconstructing authority. References never copy evidence or add weight. [04/NH_B7_PRIVACY_ENFORCEMENT_AND_PROTECTED_HANDLING_ARCHITECTURE_v1_3_CANDIDATE.md §15]

- Must never: ACCEPTED — Double-execute a replay, raise evidence weight through logs/repetition, invent retry values or provide unnecessary sensitive input. [04/NH_B7_PRIVACY_ENFORCEMENT_AND_PROTECTED_HANDLING_ARCHITECTURE_v1_3_CANDIDATE.md §15]
- Fails closed by: ACCEPTED — On uncertainty keeps visible use withheld, secrets sealed, cases open and blocks active; claims no unproved completion. [04/NH_B7_PRIVACY_ENFORCEMENT_AND_PROTECTED_HANDLING_ARCHITECTURE_v1_3_CANDIDATE.md §15]

SACL compares the new level with each in-progress operation’s material_sensitivity and signals discard of above-ceiling content before the next channel write; no partial above-ceiling output is delivered. Never replays a rejected/discarded draft. Cancellation reaches exactly operations carrying the affected session’s mode_authority_dependency_ref; independently authorized background work remains separate and must pass current checks before interactive output. Restriction precedes logging; old epochs or generations cannot deliver. [04/NH_B_INT_6_PRIVACY_FIRST_SACL_SECOND_OUTPUT_CHAIN_WIRING_v1_3_CANDIDATE.md §8] [04/NH_B_INT_6_PRIVACY_FIRST_SACL_SECOND_OUTPUT_CHAIN_WIRING_v1_3_CANDIDATE.md §14]

## Scope, paths and source dispositions

The full V10 §7Q section is placed in source order: all-stage privacy, six distinct operations, two protected tiers, four sensitivity categories, full direct/indirect derivative discovery, three conditions on multi-root visible rebuilding, visible indexes/embeddings, backups, five honest outcomes, the complete noncomplete report and preserved history. Exclusion preserves protected content outside ordinary memory; invalidated credentials remain permanently inert history. Deletion and hiding never imply internal influence removal. The standing unresolved-case block governs visible use; separately authorized internal use remains governed by its own rules.

Third-party handling retains the universal floor, contextual factors, stricter-only controls, the four-operation ladder, hypothetical labels, full-simulation approval and import/public limits. Three source conflicts are marked in the header and affected cards: destructive/five-operation/older-outcome wording, the interpretation authorization ladder, and the minor/vulnerable default. Bundle 5’s own explanation that the last is frozen predecision wording is preserved as losing wording under the contract’s V10 precedence. No conflict has been silently reconciled. A7’s compatible natural-language pause/reopening, actual-words scope, one-short-clarification rule, truthful transformation and normal longitudinal use remain explicit.

B7’s thirteen proposed mechanisms and proposed common Enforcement Contract layer are written with the proposed qualifier. Its six PIP steps, five PDE stages, sealed-record states, detector registry, discovery adapters, independent verification, three backup modes, influence enforcement, stricter-only configuration and inspection boundaries are placed. The full catalog has twenty-six record types: exclusion_event and privacy_decision retain their earlier identities at .4.4 and .6.9; .9.13 is deliberately unused rather than duplicating exclusion_event. All catalog fields, required/optional/conditional forms, controlled values, append-only/current-state roles and restart meanings are written. Common envelope/history protections remain one canonical owner, consumed by each record. The proposed deletion_case_id concept and schema case_id are both retained without selecting a final serialization mapping.

All nine operation contracts are placed in source order with identities, idempotency keys, transactions, checkpoints, partial completion, every stated state/transition, retryable and terminal outcomes, derivative handling, verification and restoration. The six-step isolation transfer preserves the verified protected copy before replacing ordinary exposure. Hiding retains thirteen controlled surface names; restriction retains all ten required rule elements. Influence removal retains the eleven-state set and makes active_verified a continuing state. A failed attempt does not terminate the protective instruction. Restoration is a new linked instruction and the stricter old/new rule governs unfinished lifting. Existing B9 mechanics and accepted values remain canonical; B7’s earlier open-values wording does not reopen their later accepted completion.

Privacy-owned interfaces cover front doors, TSC, retrieval, relevance, meaning and derived stores, simulations, outward use, backup and coordination. A2 governance discovery remains independent of semantic admission: partial, blocked and integrity-failed artifacts stay discoverable through authorized structural references without entering ordinary evidence or context. A privacy authorization query obtains its own decision through protected minimum metadata; it never recursively requires that same decision or releases raw payload first. Full relevance and routing mechanisms remain CH08-b/c.

The output interface binds the first factor to operation, exact immutable proposed delivery_payload_ref/version, purpose, destination, channel/observability, current privacy version and mode epoch/generation. A changed payload repeats privacy first then SACL second. Every write revalidates current owners and the proposed personal_mode_delivery_fence; both streaming alternatives remain explicit. Restrictive changes cancel stale work before output and before logging; exact mode_authority_dependency_ref scope preserves separately authorized background work without allowing an interactive bypass. Shared output uses the minimum active-stream level; only an owner-confirmed private unobservable path uses an individual level. Hidden existence cannot be signaled, and a model-provider refusal remains a mouth limitation. Full proposed ODC identity, claims, dispatch, delivery-state and recovery records remain CH09-d; full mode/fence and identity-factor machinery remains CH09. The interfaces here do not claim those entire packages are placed.

The restored FR-0108 requirement is placed at C-7Q.12 and its three children: a separate explicit instruction states scope, affected components and start time. The exact authorized F9 historical source was verified against the pinned blob and read whole before extraction. Only this expressly restored passage supplies behavior; the rest of that archive remains excluded. The start-time requirement is not silently mapped to normalized_scope.time_period or an invented serialization field. The recovery ledger supplies only Appendix B tracking, never behavior.

All 181 earlier C-7Q using cards (183 relationship occurrences) have one row per place. One prior C-READ.10.11 USED BY row incorrectly stamps the C-7Q root ACCEPTED; nine earlier Gated-by lines have the same error. They remain unchanged and are carried in the manifest. Current cross-piece uses receive continuation rows; the root is DESIGNED while accepted mechanisms have their own identities. All previous findings, pending restorations, missing historical Bundle 2 foundation body and CH06-d grouped-row defect remain carried.

Shared-package discovery also reviewed the AIC, durable kernel, B1/B9/B10/B-HOLD/B11/B16/B24 and formal Bundle 2 owner boundaries; none grants content access from logs, validation or coordination. A17, A19 room/chat/world, A22, framework additions and future-feature/dual-model/candor matches retain their existing privacy boundary and later placement. Inactive candidates remain named intents. The final connected paths remain CH11 and complete registers CH12. Exact storage technology, serialization, empirical detector algorithms/calibration, verification tuning and visual layout remain open, without reopening the accepted conceptual contracts.

## Plain-gate and empty-box review

The cards were compared with V10 §7Q and the full A7/B7 bodies, then checked across all nine boxes and every reciprocal relationship. Pure fields, category values and predicates can have empty TOGETHER boxes where no distinct owner or mechanism is stated; their parents explicitly consume them. Operation states and transitions use the actual contract owner, not a field’s mere presence as an invented gate. Shared rules have individual one-place USED BY rows. Record retention is not access permission. The sole plain gate is the restored human instruction act at C-7Q.12. No behavioral card is stamped BUILT; the earlier built store is only the target of an incoming use. Source output example “Claude refusal” is preserved only in the cited mouth-limitation card and is not writer advice. Proposed names remain qualified on every use.

| Card | Plain gate justification |
|---|---|
| C-7Q.12 — Explicit influence-removal scope, components and start time | The restored source explicitly requires Ness’s separate instruction as the human authorizing act; it is not a separately named Master-21 mechanism. Its scope, affected components and start time have their own cards. |
